item.title: Praat vs openSMILE vs audioFlux in 2026: Which Open-Source Speech Analysis Tool Actually Fits Your Research?
item.description: Speech researchers get squeezed from both sides. Commercial annotation suites quote per-seat prices that eat an entire grant line, while generic audio libraries give you a spectrogram and wish you luck with the rest. Three open tools cover almost every real workflow — Praat, openSMILE and audioFlux — but they were built for genuinely different jobs, and using the wrong one costs weeks.
